subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: If a disposition's approval attestation is absent, unresolved, non-compatible, bound to different disposition/edge/mapping/policy bytes, names a non-human or author-equal reviewer, or the reviewer is unauthorized or revoked under the pinned authority policy, then the system shall leave the edge blocking, emit a configuration/currency defect naming the exact approval failure and required independent review, and perform no implicit fallback to commit or PR status
intent: unauthorized-disposition defect with the failed binding and unblock
fit_criterion: each trigger independently blocks; a valid but unrelated approval reference, a green PR status without the attestation, and a changed disposition after approval all fail; only an exact current independent attestation permits FR-14
